units.Malachi 3:6: “For I am the Lord your God, and I have not changed. But you, sons of Jacob, do not refrain
units.Malachi 3:7: from the injustices of your fathers. You have turned aside from My ordinances and have not guarded them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the Lord Almighty. And you said, “How shall we return?”
units.Isaiah 40:1: Comfort, comfort My people, says God.
units.Isaiah 40:2: You priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem; comfort her. For her humiliation is fulfilled, her sin is loosed; for from the hand of the Lord she has received double for her sins.
units.Isaiah 40:3: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God.
units.Isaiah 40:4: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; all the crooked places will become straight, and the rough country will become plains.
units.Isaiah 40:5: And the glory of the Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see the salvation of God; for the Lord has spoken.
units.Isaiah 47:5: “Sit stricken and enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. You will certainly no longer be called a kingdom’s strength.
units.Isaiah 47:6: I was provoked against My people; you defiled My inheritance. I gave it into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; you made the elder’s yoke exceedingly heavy.
units.Isaiah 47:7: You said, ‘I will rule for ever.’ You did not consider these things in your heart or remember the last things.
units.Isaiah 14:3: On that day God will give you rest from pain, your wrath and the harsh slavery in which you served them,
units.Isaiah 56:6: And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—
units.Isaiah 56:7: I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
units.Isaiah 56:8: said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
units.Habakkuk 2:18: What use is a carved image, that they carved it? They formed it as a cast object, a false appearance, because its maker trusted his creation, making mute idols.
units.Habakkuk 2:19: Woe to the one saying to wood, ‘Wake and rise!’ and to stone, ‘Be lifted up!’ It is an appearance, a plate of gold and silver, and no breath at all is in it.
units.Habakkuk 2:20: But the Lord is in His holy sanctuary; let all the earth revere Him.”
units.Jeremiah 16:16: Behold, I am sending the many fishermen, says the Lord, and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send the many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from the rocks’ openings.
units.Jeremiah 16:17: Because My eyes are upon all their ways, and their wrongdoings were not hidden before My eyes.
units.Jeremiah 16:18: And I will repay double their injustices and sins, for which they profaned My land with the corpses of their abominations and with their lawless acts, by which they offended against My inheritance.
units.Leviticus 19:12: And you shall not swear by My name for an unjust cause, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord your God.
units.Leviticus 19:13: You shall not wrong your neighbour, neither shall you rob; and the wages of the hired worker shall in no wise remain with you overnight until morning.
units.Isaiah 60:3: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.
units.Deuteronomy 16:18: You shall appoint judges and recording officers for yourself in all your cities which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
units.Deuteronomy 16:19: They shall not pervert judgment, neither shall they show partiality, nor take a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise, and overthrow the words of the righteous.
units.Deuteronomy 16:20: You shall pursue justly that which is just, that you may live, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
units.Ezekiel 26:1: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 26:2: “Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, ‘Well done! She is shattered; the nations have perished. She has turned to me; the full one has been laid waste,’
units.Ezekiel 26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
units.Ezekiel 26:4: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.
units.Ezekiel 26:5: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,
units.Ezekiel 26:11: With his horses’ hoofs they will trample all your squares. He will kill your people with the sword and bring the support of your strength down to the ground.
units.Ezekiel 26:12: He will plunder your strength, strip your possessions, throw down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. He will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.
units.Ezekiel 26:13: He will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will certainly no longer be heard.
units.Ezekiel 26:14: I will make you a smooth rock, a drying place for nets. You will certainly not be rebuilt, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
units.Habakkuk 3:3: God will come from Teman, the Holy One from a mountain shaded and thickly wooded. Diapsalma. His excellence covered the heavens, and the earth is full of His praise.
units.Habakkuk 3:4: His brightness will be like light; horns are in His hands, and He established mighty love of His strength.
units.Habakkuk 3:5: A word will go before Him, and He will go out, His feet in sandals.
units.Obadiah 1:18: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will blaze against them and consume them, and there will be no bearer of fire in the house of Esau, because the Lord has spoken.
units.Psalms 17:32: For who is God except the Lord? And who is God except our God?
units.Psalms 17:33: God girds me with power and made my way blameless,
units.Psalms 17:34: He sets my feet firmly like a deer’s and makes me stand upon the heights,
units.Psalms 17:35: training my hands for war; and Thou madest my arms a bronze bow.
units.Malachi 3:1: “Look, I am sending out My messenger, and he will look to a way before My face. Suddenly the Lord whom you seek will come to His own sanctuary, and the messenger of the covenant whom you desire. Look, he is coming,” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 3:2: And who will endure the day of his entrance? Or who will stand at his appearance? For he enters like a smelting fire and like launderers’ herb.
units.Malachi 3:3: He will sit, smelting and purifying as with silver and gold. He will cleanse the sons of Levi and melt them like gold and silver, and they will be those who bring a sacrifice to the Lord in righteousness.
units.Malachi 3:4: And the sacrifice of Judah and Jerusalem will please the Lord, as in the days of old and as in the former years.
units.Psalms 46:7: Make music to our God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
units.Psalms 46:8: For God is King of all the earth; make music with understanding.
units.Psalms 46:9: God reigned over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
units.Psalms 46:10: The rulers of peoples gathered with Abraham’s God; for the mighty of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
